stages.detail: Read issue #591 and the canary-fail-fast skill it was told to pattern-match, plus the run-history schema in ts/src/history/record.ts.

Wrote the plan artifact: module breakdown, exit contract, abstention rule, recommendation heuristic, and the gate wiring the entropy ratchet requires. Resolved both of the issue's open questions (see assumptions).
agents/skills/test/canary-screech.test.ts written FIRST and run red (module-not-found across all five modules) before any implementation existed. Implementation then taken to 29 passing tests.
Five self-contained ESM modules under agents/skills/claude-code/canary-screech/scripts/ plus SKILL.md, following the canary-fail-fast shape and routing argv through the shared lib/parse-args.mjs.

Declared the new cli.mjs in BOTH harness.config.json entryPoints arrays (entropy + performance), added the scripts glob to agents/skills/vitest.config.ts coverage include and to the format:check glob in agents/skills/package.json, and registered an abstention row in agents/skills/test/gate-conformance.test.ts. maxFindings was NOT raised.
agents/skills/README.md (tree, skill list, programmatic section), docs/naming-registry.md (reserved -> shipped), docs/roadmap.md (backlog -> done, plan link, open questions recorded as resolved).

agents/skills suite + its own typecheck green with coverage; ts/ four gates (build, typecheck, format:check, test) run from ts/; entropy, perf (absolute and delta-vs-base), check-deps, and the doc link/fence checks run locally. All 19 CI checks green on PR #882. The agents/skills typecheck was MISSED on the first local pass and failed CI -- recorded here rather than smoothed over.

assumptions.decision: Standalone markdown artifact plus a GitHub Actions ::error annotation. No Slack, Teams, or webhook integration.
assumptions.source: answered by the human before work started; matches the canary-fail-fast pattern

assumptions.decision: The run-history store, test-results/reports/history-v2.jsonl, one RunRecord per line.
assumptions.source: taken by this lane. The issue listed webhook / polling / history store as candidates and did not pick one. The store was chosen because it needs no network, no credentials, and no service, which preserves the family's self-contained-and-deterministic contract, and because it already carries every field the blast needs (branch, commit_sha, timestamp, failed counts, per-test area and failure_category).

assumptions.decision: None. The skill emits the blast and the chat-ready block; it never posts them and writes nothing but the --out artifact.
Advisory by default (exit 0 whatever it finds); --strict opts into the exit contract 1=red, 3=abstained, 0=green.
assumptions.source: taken by this lane, mirroring the #508 D3/D4 convention every other skill CLI in this family follows

assumptions.decision: A store with no run for the requested branch prints a loud ABSTAINED line and never the green copy; under --strict it exits 3. A MISSING store is a different thing and exits 1.
assumptions.source: taken by this lane, per the repo's no-silent-abstention doctrine (#508). A green verdict derived from zero observations is the failure mode the doctrine exists to prevent.

assumptions.topic: recommendation when ownership data is absent
assumptions.source: taken by this lane. Recommending an action from absent area data would be a confident answer derived from nothing.

assumptions.decision: The range is (last green commit, first red commit]. Only the observed first-red commit is enumerated; interior commits are not, because enumerating them needs git and this skill shells out to nothing. When no green run precedes the break the range is reported bounded:false rather than implying a lower bound.
Flipped to done / shipped in this change, on the convention that the row lands with the merge commit.
assumptions.source: taken by this lane, matching how the sibling skill rows were handled

assumptions.decision: Four of the five findings this change first introduced were FIXED by splitting functions (assessBranch 12/53 lines, clusterFailures 23 over the error threshold, main 11). The fifth -- the coupling ratio on scripts/cli.mjs -- got a reviewed deltaAllowances entry scoped to agents/skills/claude-code/*/scripts/cli.mjs. No ceiling, baseline, or maxFindings was raised.
assumptions.source: taken by this lane after CI failed the delta rule on the first push. The coupling finding is structural (a skill CLI imports its pure modules plus parse-args and is imported only by its test, which IS a ratio of 1.00); canary-katana's cli.mjs already trips it from the absolute backlog, and the entry mirrors the two ts/src CLI entries already in that list. Re-measured against a detached base worktree the way CI does: 1 new, 1 allowed, 0 blocking, 229 vs 228 at the base, ceiling 233.

not_done: No CI workflow was added that runs the siren on this repo's own default branch. The SKILL.md documents the wiring, but adopting it here is a separate scope call (the repo's dogfood.yml is where it would land) and #591 did not ask for it.
